name: Polyphemus Moth
desc: Polyphemus Moth (Antheraea polyphemus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Antheraea polyphemus, the Polyphemus moth, is a North American member of the family Saturniidae, the giant silk moths. It is a tan-colored moth, with an average wingspan of 15 cm (6 in).
